none: PAS CAM-065327: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN GRATIAN-VS AVGG AVG ; R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE

A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian, 367-383. Mint is Lyon, 367-375, Reece period 19. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads DN GRATIAN-VS AVGG AVG. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm. Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Reverse fields and exergue read: - branch//LVGP.
